swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB uses SOT-23-3 (3-pin, DBZ (SOT-23-3)) while TPS7A0233PDBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV (SOT-23-5)); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Soldering TPS7A0233PDBVR onto a LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs significantly (LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 0.1 µF p.11 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 1 µF p.5); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS7A0233PDBVR is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB at 30 V rec. (35 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 100 mA (p.5) compared to TPS7A0233PDBVR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs by 630 mV (LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 900 mV p.5 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 270 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo at cold/hot corners.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 33% (LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 269.6 °C/W p.4 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 181.9 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-3) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 2 (VIN vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 2000 µA (p.5) vs 0.025 µA (p.6), max output current is 100 mA (p.5) vs 200 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 30 V (p.4) vs 6 V (p.5), typical dropout is 900 mV (p.5) vs 270 mV (p.6), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 269.6 vs 181.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
